original_hypothesis: Zedruu controls Immortal Coil and donates it while Zur supplies Rest in Peace.
finding: Immortal Coil has black color identity and cannot be in Zedruu's Jeskai deck. Zur's Esper deck can contain it, but Zedruu cannot donate a permanent still controlled by the teammate. A separately specified control-transfer engine could change the configuration, but was absent from this proposed line.
replacement: The published profile uses A's legal blue Illusions of Grandeur and B's tutored Seal of Cleansing. It is an incremental shared-life swing, not a claimed direct team-loss combo.

original_hypothesis: Belbe automatically gives both active teammates four mana when both opponents lost life.
finding: CR 805.9 assigns an active-player reference to one specific active player chosen by the ability controller. There is one Belbe trigger for that postcombat main phase, not an automatic grant to both heads.
replacement: The profile explicitly chooses the active recipient, often Heartless’s controller.
